candidates.fdm: A disc or ring of printed buckets/blades. Prints standing or as a loft. 507 #430-437. Teaching mill wheel. No flume.
candidates.name: overshot_wheel
candidates.why: The gravity water wheel. Overshot buckets, undershot blades, breast in between. Not an Archimedes conveyor and not a Pelton. The missing 507 water-wheel kit.

candidates.api_shape: pelton_wheel(pitch_d, buckets, cusp) -> a disc of double-cusp buckets
candidates.fdm: Buckets print as a ring or individually on a hub. The jet is not a part. Impulse turbine, high head.
candidates.name: pelton_wheel
candidates.why: Pelton 1870s. Splitter-ridge buckets, atmospheric runner. Distinct from an overshot (gravity, no jet) and from a centrifugal impeller (enclosed, reaction).

candidates.api_shape: savonius(d, h, n=2, overlap) -> half-cylinders on a vertical shaft
candidates.fdm: Two or three half-pipes. Prints. Drag VAWT. Self-starting, low tip-speed. The most FDM-native wind rotor.
candidates.name: savonius_rotor
candidates.why: Savonius 1922. Vertical-axis drag. Not a Darrieus (lift) and not a propeller. Anemometers, small chargers, teaching.

candidates.api_shape: darrieus(h, r, blades, kind='troposkein'|'H') -> airfoils on a vertical shaft
candidates.fdm: Printed airfoils or a lofted troposkein. Lift VAWT. Needs a start (often paired with Savonius).
candidates.name: darrieus_rotor
candidates.why: Darrieus 1931. The lift vertical-axis. Distinct from Savonius. H-rotor is the easy print; eggbeater is the classic.

candidates.api_shape: propeller_blade(r, pitch, sections) or a 2-3 blade hub. HAWT / marine / aircraft cell
candidates.fdm: A lofted airfoil. Prints standing. One blade or a small hub. A tower + nacelle is a product.
candidates.name: propeller_blade
candidates.why: Horizontal-axis lift rotor. The other wind family. centrifugal_impeller is a radial pump/fan; this is an axial propeller.

candidates.api_shape: a hollow arm with rearward jets, Hero / lawn sprinkler, 507 #438
candidates.fdm: A T-tube with two jets. Prints. Reaction, no buckets.
candidates.name: barker_mill
candidates.why: Barker's mill. The named 507 reaction wheel. Teaching, not a plant.

candidates.api_shape: a mixed-flow runner; the scroll case is a product
candidates.fdm: Prints as a teaching cutaway. Needs a volute and a draft tube to work.
candidates.name: francis_runner
candidates.why: Francis 1849. The common hydro runner. After impeller + Pelton. Do not emit a powerhouse.

candidates.api_shape: an axial runner with variable pitch
candidates.fdm: Prints. Pitch mechanism is a product.
candidates.name: kaplan_runner
candidates.why: Kaplan. A propeller with adjustable blades. The blade is propeller_blade; the hub actuator is a product.

candidates.name: windmill_product
candidates.why: 507 #485-486 are finished mills. The rotor is the primitive.

rejected.name: archimedes_as_turbine_only
rejected.why: archimedes_screw already ships as a conveyor. It can run as a low-head turbine; that is a usecase note, not a second kit.

rejected.name: centrifugal_impeller_again
rejected.why: Proposed on the fluid slice as a pump/fan. Do not re-file it as a water wheel.

summary:
Prime-mover rotors extract work from a fluid. Water wheels split by where the stream hits: undershot (blades, low head), breast, overshot (buckets, high head). Modern hydro splits impulse (Pelton, Turgo, cross-flow) vs reaction (Francis mixed-flow, Kaplan axial). Wind splits drag (Savonius) vs lift (Darrieus VAWT, propeller HAWT). 507 is thick: water wheels 430-438, Barker's mill 438, windmills 485-486, paddles 487/489. Fluid slice already proposed centrifugal_impeller as a pump/fan; this slice owns the prime-mover rotors that are not that impeller.

Catalog has no wheel or turbine rotor. Grep of mechlib/ for Pelton, Savonius, Darrieus, overshot, water wheel, turbine, windmill, impeller is empty. Neighbours: archimedes_screw (conveyor helix, also used as a low-head turbine), flywheel (stores, does not extract), proposed centrifugal_impeller (dynamic pump). A mill building is a product. A Pelton bucket wheel is a semi-primitive.

FDM reality. overshot_wheel is a rim of buckets, prints as a disc + buckets, the teaching water wheel. undershot is flat or curved blades on a rim. Pelton is a disc of double-cusp buckets around a pitch circle; the jet is not printed. Savonius is two (or three) half-cylinders on a vertical shaft, the most FDM-native wind rotor. Darrieus is two or three airfoils on a vertical shaft (troposkein or H-rotor). A propeller / HAWT blade is an airfoil loft; one blade is a primitive, a 3-blade turbine on a tower is a product. Francis and Kaplan need a scroll case and a draft tube; the runner can print as a teaching cutaway, the plant cannot. Barker's mill is a reaction sprinkler (Hero / lawn). Do not emit a dam.
title: Water wheels, turbines, and wind rotors
